samples.caption: Some object is moved followed by a goat bleats
samples.text: I tiptoed closer, but the stick snapped, and the goat went 'Baaa!'

samples.caption: Wind blows and birds chirp
samples.text: Whoa, the kite’s flying high! Let me run—wind’s strong, and birds are chirping!

samples.caption: Humming and vibrating of an engine
samples.text: Shift to neutral first—let me adjust the carburetor while the engine's warm.

samples.caption: Water splashes gently, rapid breathing is present, a baby grunts happily, and an adult female laughs
samples.text: Look at you, little one! Splash, splash—oh, you’re such a giggler! More water, okay? Don’t make a mess!

samples.caption: A dog growls then a cat meows, the dog then barks
samples.text: Hey, Max, leave the cat alone! She's just trying to nap! Good boy, sit.

samples.caption: A train using its horn as it comes closer
samples.text: Hey, the train's getting louder! Let's move back!

samples.caption: Someone types on a keyboard
samples.text: Let me finish this report before the meeting starts. Just need to type up the final numbers...

samples.caption: A man sing and play a guitar followed by someone whistling
samples.text: I'll whistle along while you play that song on the guitar!

samples.caption: A gun is adjusted, and then multiple gunshots fire nearby
samples.text: Got to tweak the sights... better hold steady... Fire! Fire! Fire!

samples.caption: Hissing by an animal
samples.text: Back up! There's a hissing critter in the bushes—don't make it mad!

samples.caption: Large sharp explosions one after another with some bug noises from outside
samples.text: These fireworks are going off one after another, and those crickets are driving me crazy! Gotta move the party or I’ll lose my mind!

samples.caption: Digital beeping followed by a ring
samples.text: I pressed send, waited through the beeps, and finally heard the ring. Someone's there!

samples.caption: Sirens mixed with passing traffic
samples.text: Hey, you gotta pull over! That siren's getting closer—let's move or we're stuck!

samples.caption: A sewing machine intermittently makes operating noises
samples.text: I’m trying to finish this quilt for Sarah’s birthday, but the needle keeps getting stuck. Let me oil the machine again.

samples.caption: Someone saws wood with a manual saw
samples.text: Almost got the birdhouse frame ready, this wood is tough but the cut’s getting clean.

samples.caption: A flock of ducks quacking alongside leaves loudly rustling followed by chickens clucking
samples.text: Come on, you bunch of greedy ducks! The wind's pickin' up, but I got feed to spare!

samples.caption: A toilet is flushed
samples.text: Finally, the toilet's working again! No more waiting!

samples.caption: Knocking and banging followed by footsteps and a door opening
samples.text: Hold on, I'm coming! Who's there? Okay, I'm opening the door—what's so urgent?

samples.caption: A person slurping followed by a firecracker popping then liquid fizzing before drums music plays in the background
samples.text: Hey, this soda's way too cold—*slurp*—oh! Did you just set off that firework? *pop*—Whoa, it’s fizzy now! *fizz*—Let’s dance before the music starts!

samples.caption: A large propeller airplane takes off and flies away into the distance
samples.text: Take care! That engine's getting loud, and I can feel the ground shake. Just wave goodbye when you're up where they can see!

samples.caption: A small dog yipping and barking
samples.text: Stop barking at the door, little guy! Let's go inside!

samples.caption: Bees are flying and whipping around then suddenly a man with an accent says something
samples.text: These bees won't leave me alone! Hey, you with the bees?!

samples.caption: A gun fires and echoes in the distance
samples.text: Did you hear that? Something just went off in the distance. We need to get out of here, now!

samples.caption: A loud car engine idles
samples.text: Man, this engine won't start! Keep trying, come on!

samples.caption: A chime melody playing
samples.text: Hey, hurry up! The cake's almost ready—don’t let the last chime catch you outside!

samples.caption: The wind blows, something clinks and then a rushing whoosh sound and a sheep beys
samples.text: Hey, hold on there, slippery lamb! Don’t run into that fence again—heard that clink? Wind’s picking up, jacket’s flapping like a flag!

samples.caption: A power drill is being used to cut wood
samples.text: Almost got the angles right, just need to cut these wood pieces faster.

samples.caption: A horn is triggered two times
samples.text: Two short blasts—get back on defense!

samples.caption: A cat makes meow noises, followed by human imitations, followed by laughter
samples.text: Hey, Mr. Whiskers, want some attention? Let me try that meow again... Ha, you’re laughing at me, aren’t you?

samples.caption: Water flows quickly down a stream
samples.text: Water's pushing hard—reinforce the wall before it breaks!

samples.caption: Someone whistles a tune with an instrumental
samples.text: Just finished fixing the bike, and I’ve got this tune stuck in my head—sounds like the old radio’s playing it too!

samples.caption: A machine runs and grinds a hard object as it rubs against it
samples.text: Let me grind these beans faster, this machine’s been running forever!

samples.caption: An engine idling
samples.text: Alright, let's see... Engine's been idling smooth. Gotta turn the key, rev it up a notch. Check the carb—any leaks? Should hold steady.

samples.caption: Bells are clanging in different tones
samples.text: Come on, we’re late! The bells are going crazy—better hurry or we’ll miss the start!

samples.caption: Continuous emergency sirens passing by
samples.text: Hey, hurry up! That siren’s getting closer—let’s move or we’ll be stuck here!

samples.caption: Large waves come ashore on a beach with some tapping noise at one point
samples.text: Ugh, these waves keep wrecking my castle! Maybe I should move further up the shore.

samples.caption: Aircraft is soaring and strong sounds of wind gusts are heard from the rotor blade
samples.text: Hold on tight, the winds are really picking up! We’ll ride this out!

samples.caption: Breathing is followed by several clacks and then a toilet flush
samples.text: Okay, just a quick puff. Flush it down, wash up, and out.

samples.caption: A motorcycle starts and the engine revs
samples.text: Stupid thing won’t start! Turn over, already!

samples.caption: A loud police siren wails and a faint fire truck siren beeps
samples.text: Hey, move over! Police coming through! Almost late for the party, but that fire truck’s backup light’s on—better hurry!

samples.caption: A large clock bongs methodically while mechanics whir
samples.text: Finally, the old clock’s back on track. Let’s give it a good wind and see if it stays put!

samples.caption: Loud clicking, vibrations from a sewing machine
samples.text: Getting the hem right, but this machine’s actin’ up again. Gotta adjust the tension before it snags.

samples.caption: Water flowing followed by rustling
samples.text: The water’s cold here. Wait... did something just move in the trees?

samples.caption: Cuckoo clock chimes
samples.text: Better check the pie, that cuckoo clock’s been counting every second since I baked it!

samples.caption: Wind is blowing hard
samples.text: Hey, hold that corner down! The wind's really messing with the tarp!

samples.caption: Heavy wind and distant music with some clanking
samples.text: Gotta tie this tarp down before it flies... that wind’s wild! And what’s that clanging? Sounds like the crates are dancing... someone’s party’s real loud out here!

samples.caption: Several gunshots fire in the distance, as explosions sound nearby, followed by people yelling quietly
samples.text: Take cover! There's heavy gunfire and blasts everywhere. Stay low and move toward the shelter—people are hurt and need help!

samples.caption: Someone types really fast on an old typewriter and the handle rings at the end of a line of type and the bar is pushed to the beginning
samples.text: I’m racing against time to finish this story—every key flies like lightning, that clack of the carriage return driving me forward. Just need a few more lines before the deadline hits!

samples.caption: Water in toilet is being flushed and draining sound
samples.text: Hey, hold on! The toilet’s acting up again—flush won’t stop!

samples.caption: Siren whaling and motor revving then something is dropped
samples.text: Whoa, hold on! That box is way too heavy—wait, what’s that wailing? Better move it before the cop car arrives! Oops, dropped it!

samples.caption: A train approaches and blows a horn
samples.text: Wait for the train to pass first! Oh no, it's coming!

samples.caption: A device beeps rapidly multiple times
samples.text: The monitor’s going crazy—numbers spiking, alarms flashing. I need more time before it triggers!

samples.caption: A buzzing noise and a clip-clop sound
samples.text: Come on, boy, let's move—why does that fly keep buzzing around you?

samples.caption: A sewing machine is operating and rhythmically clacking
samples.text: Need to finish these stitches before mom's birthday. This fabric is tricky, but the machine is going steady. Almost there!

samples.caption: A train sounds its horn
samples.text: I need to hurry or I'll miss my train, the doors are closing!

samples.caption: A pig oinking along with walking noises in the background later joined by a goat bleating
samples.text: Feed the pig first—goat's in the pen again!

samples.caption: Gunshots occur, then water splashes, ducks quack and dogs whine
samples.text: He pulled the trigger, and the dog jumped into the water, barking as the duck flew past.

samples.caption: A brief horn followed by the humming of an oncoming train followed by a longer horn
samples.text: Hey, look out! Train's coming fast—let's move back!

samples.caption: Sheeps bleat and an engine runs in the background
samples.text: Hurry up, the sheep are restless and the truck's idling!

samples.caption: Crinkling and rustling with wind blowing
samples.text: These stupid keys must be in the bag... why is the wind making this so hard?!

samples.caption: Rhythmic squeaking sound is present, a hoofed animal is trotting, and vehicle horns are blowing
samples.text: Watch out for that cart! Those blasted horns won’t stop. I’m late as it is!

samples.caption: A low muffled engine idles followed by a slow rev and hum by the engine
samples.text: Mirror’s clear, gear in neutral. Let the engine warm up a bit longer.

samples.caption: Music and cow mooing birds chirping engine running
samples.text: Country tunes playing, tractor's ready. Let's round up those cows before they get too rowdy!

samples.caption: Church bells ring several times loudly in the distance
samples.text: Got to run! Don't want to miss the service, even though those bells are loud enough to wake the whole town!

samples.caption: Wind blows and goats bleat
samples.text: These little goats won't stop making noise, and this wind keeps messing up my fence posts!

samples.caption: A race car revs up loudly several times
samples.text: Alright, let's fire up the engine—time to check if she's ready for the track!

samples.caption: Several birds tweet while someone walks
samples.text: Better spread these seeds quick before the birds notice!

samples.caption: A drill is being used
samples.text: Hey, can you hold the ladder steady? I’m trying to drill these brackets before the crew arrives!

samples.caption: A duck quacks continuously as bugs hum in the background
samples.text: Hey, over here, buddy! I’ve got the bread—wait, why’s that duck quacking so much? And these flies won’t stop buzzing!

samples.caption: Water splashes and a chicken crows in the distance followed by metallic banging
samples.text: I’ll wash these greens by the pond, water’s just right. Don’t mind the rooster crowing since dawn or that old bucket clanging.

samples.caption: A sewing machine starting slow and speeding up
samples.text: Let me get the swing going—start slow, then push harder each time!

samples.caption: A train horn blares loudly and warning bells sound in the distance
samples.text: Watch out! That train's coming fast—we need to stop now!

samples.caption: A dog growling and breathing aloud as birds chirp in the background
samples.text: Dog's breathing heavy and growling. I'm trying to calm him before the neighbors come. Birds keep chirping!

samples.caption: Birds wings flapping
samples.text: Hey! I just scared those birds away with my stone!

samples.caption: Water splashes and wind blows
samples.text: Hey, the waves keep splashing my sandcastle! And this wind won’t stop blowing the sand away!

samples.caption: A motor cycle engine is idling then gets switched off and is switched on again
samples.text: Let me check if the bike's ready. Hmm, the engine's warm... I'll turn it off and start it up again to make sure.

samples.caption: The wind blowing followed by the sound of a galloping horse
samples.text: Head for the canyon! If you can keep up with the wind, we might lose them!

samples.caption: Clock is tick locking and hourly bells are ringing
samples.text: Got to wind the old clock before it stops.

samples.caption: Wind blows and a vehicle passes quickly
samples.text: Hey, can you hear me? This wind’s blowing my scarf everywhere! Oh, that car just zoomed by—way too fast!

samples.caption: Silverware clanks against each other, a dish is set on a wooden table, and a plastic bag crinkles
samples.text: I'll set the plate down, grab the forks from the bag, and start setting the table.

samples.caption: Engine racing at a race track. People clapping
samples.text: Almost ready! Let's tighten this wheel before they hit the track—the crowd's going nuts every time that engine roars!

samples.caption: A frog croaks as soft tinkles sound in the distance
samples.text: I've got to catch that frog before those tinkles scare it off!

samples.caption: A bell chiming along with a clock ticking
samples.text: I’ve got to wind the old thing before it stops again. That bell’s been ringing all morning—better not be late for work!

samples.caption: Sharp metal screeching briefly as a train runs on railroad tracks and a train horn blows repeatedly
samples.text: Train's about to leave! I'm gonna be late!

samples.caption: Cats are caterwauling, thumping occurs, and an electronic device is playing in the background
samples.text: These cats are so loud! And that thumping—can someone turn down the TV?

samples.caption: A toilets flushed followed by dripping
samples.text: I'll check if the toilet's leaking again, it's been driving me crazy.

samples.caption: Metal sliding against metal followed by sheep Beijing
samples.text: Slid the gate open real quick, now the sheep are escapin’ toward the market!

samples.caption: Engine running and revving with strong blowing wind
samples.text: Need to keep the RPMs high, the wind's not letting up!

samples.caption: A person barks like a dog and sighs
samples.text: Okay, fetch! *bark* ... Come on, boy! *sigh*

samples.caption: Insects and Bird vocalization
samples.text: Hey, watch out! That butterfly’s wings are flapping too fast! The buzzing bees and chirping birds won’t let me get close!

samples.caption: Rapid tapping against a surface
samples.text: I can't wait any longer, I'm tapping my fingers on the table. Where are you? This is taking forever!

samples.caption: A toilet flushing water down the drain
samples.text: Hey, finish up in there! The water's been running forever. Hurry and wash your hands before dinner!

samples.caption: Unknown animal making noise while car engine revs by
samples.text: Hey, what's that chirping? Let me try starting the car again.

samples.caption: A train passes and blows a horn
samples.text: I told him to call when the train blows its horn, but he’s always late!

samples.caption: A toilet is flushed followed by a slight tapping
samples.text: Okay, the toilet's doing that tap thing again. Gotta adjust the float before it floods.

samples.caption: Two men communicating with each other as a swarm of insects buzz during a series of metal and wood clanking alongside birds chirping in the background
samples.text: Pass me the hammer, will ya? This fence post’s slipping again. Buzzin’ pests and that racket from the saw—how’s the neighbor’s bird standin’ it?

samples.caption: A tapping noise followed by water running
samples.text: I think the tap's loose again—I'll need to tighten it before the water bill goes through the roof!

samples.caption: A distant voice, then a bell and a horn, and a vehicle passing by on rails
samples.text: About time they got here... hear that horn? Bell just rang. Better hurry, or I'll miss the train. Can't make out what the announcer's saying, but it's definitely leaving soon.

samples.caption: Steam engine train going down tracks
samples.text: We’re gonna be late again! This train doesn’t stop for anyone!

samples.caption: Birds chirping and bees buzzing outdoors
samples.text: Man, these bees are relentless! Keep swatting them away from my picnic. At least the birds are singing nicely. Maybe move to a shadier spot?

samples.caption: Thunder rumbles
samples.text: The storm's getting closer—let's run to the car before it hits!

samples.caption: Someone is whistling a song
samples.text: Let me try whistling that tune again—maybe it’ll stick in my head this time!

samples.caption: People laughing
samples.text: Hey, did you see his face when the cake fell? This is the best night ever!

samples.caption: A drill is buzzing as it drills into a hard surface
samples.text: Man, this drill’s going crazy! Can’t hear a thing over this noise. Hand me that bolt over there, would ya?

samples.caption: Hands clapping in applause
samples.text: You're all doing great! Let's keep this energy up and finish strong!

samples.caption: Food is frying and objects are moved around
samples.text: Almost done, just need to flip these pancakes and grab the plates.

samples.caption: Cars pass as horns honk
samples.text: Ugh, this noise is driving me crazy! How am I supposed to cross with all these horns blaring?!

samples.caption: Ducks honking and quacking
samples.text: Look, the ducks are getting excited! More bread, come on!

samples.caption: Rain falls heavily on a metal roof and windows
samples.text: Come on, we’ve got to get the clothes in before this downpour ruins everything! The wind’s picking up, and the water’s already pooling out here!

samples.caption: Emergency siren passing and fading away
samples.text: Hey, better pull over quick—ambulance coming through!
